mr_title: fix(cdk/overlay): not setting correct opacity in high contrast mode on Firefox
mr_description:
The backdrop styles were never switches to the `cdk-high-contrast` mixin which means that
they won't work on Firefox. These changes switch to using the mixin and update the docs.

expected_issues.title: Relative Sass import breaks in the published package layout
expected_issues.description:
The overlay stylesheet now imports '../a11y/a11y', but this file is copied to the top level of the published @angular/cdk package where that relative path does not exist, so `@import '~@angular/cdk/overlay'` fails to compile.

The comment retained beside this change explicitly warned that the high-contrast mixin cannot be used here because the import path to _a11y.scss cannot be normalised both for sources and for the distributed file (#10908). Consumers importing the overlay styles through the shorthand path get a Sass compilation error. The media query must stay inlined.
